preamble_table_bmc_cells.Z_following_logic_low: 11101000 (channel-A subframe start of block / block boundary)
preamble_table_bmc_cells.Z_following_logic_high: 00010111 (channel-A subframe start of block; inverted polarity)
preamble_table_bmc_cells.note: Each preamble is 8 BMC cells = 4 bit-times. The three patterns intentionally break BMC's 'transition every bit boundary' rule with three-cell-long pulses, guaranteeing they cannot appear in regular BMC-coded data and so locate subframe / frame / block boundaries unambiguously.

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.parity_polynomial: Even parity over bits 4-30 (Aux + Audio + V + U + C). Receiver verifies; transmitter computes.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.data_byte_order_within_audio: 20-bit audio is LSB-first within bits 8-27 (LSB at bit 8, MSB at bit 27)
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.channel_status_aggregation: 1 bit per subframe; aggregated 192 bits per channel per block. Channel-status word is identical between channel A and channel B in consumer S/PDIF.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.user_data_aggregation: 1 bit per subframe; aggregated 192 bits per channel per block.

byte_0.bit_0: 0 = Consumer / 1 = Professional (changes byte 0 onward to AES3 channel-status word)
byte_0.bits_6_7: Mode (defines subsequent bytes; non-zero values undefined)

byte_1.bits_0_6: Audio source category (general, CD-DA, DAT, DVD, etc.)
byte_1.bit_7: L-bit (original / copy, only defined when copy restrict = 0)

byte_3.bits_0_3: Sampling frequency (0000 = 44.1 kHz, 0100 = 48 kHz, 1100 = 32 kHz, etc.)
byte_3.bits_4_5: Clock accuracy (10 = 50 ppm, 00 = 1000 ppm, 01 = variable pitch)

byte_4.bits_1_3: Sample length (0 = undefined, 1-4 = word length minus 1-4 bits, 5 = full word length)

consumer_channel_status_byte_layout.bytes_5_10_plus_byte_11_bits_0_3: EAN-13 code (possibly in BCD); byte 11 bits 4-7 = undefined / padding on 13-digit EAN.
consumer_channel_status_byte_layout.bytes_15_21: Continuation of ISRC (ISRC = 2 alphabetic + 3 alphanumeric + 7 numeric, fitting in ~7.5 bytes).

carrier_to_sample_rate_relationship: Frame rate = sample rate (one frame per sample period). Bit clock = 64 × sample rate (because each frame = 64 BMC cells × 2 = 128 BMC cells; 64 data bits per frame across two subframes). The IEC 61937 carrier rate is usually 64 × the underlying symbol rate of the compressed bitstream.

default_signal_values_when_idle.transmitter_no_audio: Continue emitting valid IEC 60958 frames with audio sample = 0 and Validity bit V = 1, OR pause / drop the line — implementation-defined.
default_signal_values_when_idle.receiver_lost_sync: Mute analog output and wait for BMC lock + preamble alignment to be re-established.
